title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-06-04
source: sbd > ?? > wav > audacity(snaps,crackles,pops) > wavmerge > cdwav > tlh(flaclevel8) > flac16

ai_review.summary: Excellent mono audience recording of an acoustic set featuring sweet Jerry vocals and a standout rendition of Black Peter.
ai_review.review: The acoustic portion of this show is praised for its superb playing and especially Jerry Garcia’s sweet, lovely voice. Reviewers note the audio is exceptional—clear and pleasing even in the mono Taper's Section source—though one version misses the opening song and has a cut in “Swing Low.” Overall the performance is considered outstanding with Black Peter highlighted as a high point.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently strong praise for both musical performance and audio quality across four reviews, with only minor criticisms about missing material.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mono Taper's Section capture; crystal‑clear acoustic mix, sweet vocals. Missing first song and a cut in “Swing Low” on this particular version.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic set runs smoothly with tight playing; the missing intro does not detract from the overall flow, and the material is praised as outstanding.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Voice described as sweet, lovely, and exceptionally clear throughout the acoustic set.
